_comment_exclusion_rules: Workload-only scope rules. Staleness views keep showing these tickets. issue_type_ids is preferred once the real Jira type IDs are filled in; names act as migration aliases.

exclusion_rules.reason: Administrative change record; excluded from workload only

_comment_status_defaults: Workload-only status policy. STATUS_RESPONSIBLE_PARTY in staleness.py is unchanged. Waiting for Approval, Pending and Peer Review stay conservative on purpose: an internal approval must never be hidden as client work.
_comment_client_approval: Fill these in to turn 'Waiting for Approval' into a confirmed client estimate-approval wait for a given project. Until then those tickets surface under Needs review instead of being hidden.
_comment_identities: accountIds, not display names. internal_account_ids covers colleagues outside the seven-person team (account managers, other squads). client_approver_ids_by_client lists the people actually authorised to approve estimates or accept delivery.
_comment_member_settings: Intentionally empty: capacity must be calibrated from a few weeks of real active work, not invented. Keys are Jira accountIds. Supported fields: planning_capacity_units, max_started_tickets, role_group, assignment_eligible, availability.
_comment_unassigned: Enabling include_unassigned requires an explicit BI-team ownership scope, e.g. 'component in ("BI Reporting")'. Without it the page says the backlog is not configured instead of showing a misleading zero.
